title: Рослесхоз разъяснил, какие некапитальные строения допустимы в городских лесах
summary: С 1 сентября 2026 года вступило в силу распоряжение Правительства России, дополнившее перечень некапитальных строений и сооружений, допустимых к размещению в городских лесах. Теперь в городских лесах при осуществлении рекреационной деятельности разрешено устанавливать беседки, навесы, скамейки, площадки для игр и занятий спортом, пешеходные дорожки и тропы. Размещение объектов допускается только на участках, не занятых лесными насаждениями. Сплошные и выборочные рубки для этих целей запрещены.

К участию приглашают студентов лесных и технических специальностей, в том числе из Беларуси. Им предстоит решать прикладные задачи по трём направлениям: охрана лесов от пожаров, лесоустройство, защита и воспроизводство лесных ресурсов. summary: Делегация Федерального агентства лесного хозяйства посетила Беларусь с рабочим визитом, который продлился с 25 по 28 августа 2026 года. Заместитель руководителя Рослесхоза Вячеслав Спиренков и министр лесного хозяйства Республики Беларусь Сергей Ульдинович обсудили цифровизацию отрасли и применение искусственного интеллекта. summary: Архангельский ЦБК провёл опрос среди покупателей целлюлозно-бумажной продукции на внутреннем рынке. Более 40% респондентов считают наличие сертификации у производителей необходимым условием. Это подтверждает, что запрос на подтверждение ответственного лесопользования формируется непосредственно со стороны рынка. Сертификация становится инструментом для оценки происхождения сырья, цепочек поставок и экологичности продукции, а также может влиять на расчёт экологического сбора.

summary: 7–9 октября в Конгресс-центре МГТУ им. Н. Э. Баумана пройдут «Российская неделя бумаги – 2026» и «Российский лесотехнический форум – 2026». Регистрация уже открыта. title: Рослесхоз: в Свердловской области завершены 8 приоритетных инвестпроектов в ЛПК
summary: Руководитель Рослесхоза Иван Советников посетил Свердловскую область с рабочей поездкой. Он побывал на предприятии ООО «Синергия», где завершён приоритетный инвестиционный проект в сфере ЛПК. Всего в регионе успешно реализованы 8 таких проектов, что позволило вовлечь в оборот расчётную лесосеку в объёме 3,5 млн м³. Совмещение процессов пиролиза и активации в одном реакторе позволяет снизить энергозатраты на 30–40%. Разработчики уже создали 3D-модель, провели виртуальные испытания и готовят опытный образец.

title: Snabb-KPI: Inflationstakten 0,3 procent i augusti 2026
summary: Den preliminära inflationstakten enligt KPI för augusti 2026 var 0,3 procent, vilket var en uppgång från 0,2 procent i juli. Månadsförändringen för KPI från juli till augusti var -0,3 procent. Den ordinarie publiceringen för augusti sker den 14 september.

title: Rekordkvartal för fondförsäkring
summary: Under det andra kvartalet 2026 ökade marknadsvärdet på försäkrings- och tjänstepensionsföretagens placeringstillgångar 8,3 procent till ny rekordnivå om 8 939 miljarder kronor. Stark börsutveckling i kvartalet hjälpte aktierelaterade placeringar och fondförsäkring ökade 14,5 procent till 2 665 miljarder.

title: Starkt andra kvartal för bytesbalansen
summary: Under det andra kvartalet 2026 ser vi en ökning av både export och import inom de flesta delarna av bytesbalansen, där främst varuimporten ökar starkt. Den finansiella balansen visar nettotillgångar på 178,7 miljarder kronor, där portfölj- och direktinvesteringar står för den största delen av uppgången.

title: Tjänsteexporten stärker nettot
summary: Efter en period med starkare utveckling inom tjänsteimporten är det under andra kvartalet i stället tjänsteexporten som uppvisar en bredare och starkare utveckling.

title: BNP ökade andra kvartalet 2026
summary: Sveriges BNP ökade med 1,6 procent under andra kvartalet, säsongrensat och jämfört med kvartalet innan. Tillväxten förklaras bland annat av uppgångar i fasta bruttoinvesteringar, export och hushållens konsumtionsutgifter medan lagerinvesteringar motverkade utvecklingen. Kalenderkorrigerat och jämfört med andra kvartalet 2025 ökade BNP med 3,3 procent.

title: Antalet anställningar fortsatte att öka i juni
summary: Antalet pågående anställningar ökade med 0,9 procent jämfört med juni föregående år. Under samma period har antalet arbetade timmar ökat med 3,3 procent och uppgick till 656 miljoner timmar. Andel sjukfrånvaro var 1,5 procent. Den totala lönesumman för juni var 219 miljarder kronor.

title: Detaljhandelns försäljningsvolym i stort sett oförändrad i juli 2026
summary: Detaljhandelns försäljningsvolym minskade med 0,2 procent i juli 2026 jämfört med föregående månad i kalenderkorrigerade och säsongrensade tal. Sällanköpsvaruhandelns försäljningsvolym minskade med 0,4 procent medan försäljningsvolymen i dagligvaruhandeln exklusive Systembolaget ökade med 0,9 procent.

title: Utbetalda hem och villa-ersättningar minskade
summary: De utbetalda försäkringsersättningarna i hem- och villaförsäkring minskade för andra raka året under 2025. Inom försäkringstypen företags- och fastighetsförsäkring ökade däremot utbetalningarna.

title: Efterfrågan på arbetskraft på uppgång
summary: Under andra kvartalet fanns det totalt 159 500 lediga jobb på den svenska arbetsmarknaden. Det är 8 procent fler jobb än andra kvartalet 2025, men skillnaden ligger inom osäkerhetsmarginalen.

title: SKB Kontur Launches E-Document Exchange Between Russia, Uzbekistan
summary: SKB Kontur has launched cross-border electronic document exchange, allowing Russian companies to exchange legally binding e-documents with Uzbek partners.

summary: Uzbekistan has approved rules for selecting tourism businesses to participate in international tourism fairs and exhibitions, including quotas.

title: Uzbekistan to Pay Citizens for Reporting Licensing Violations
summary: Uzbekistan will pay citizens and organisations 10% of fines imposed for confirmed violations of licensing and permit requirements.

title: Suspect Detained in Ferghana Region Corruption Case
summary: A suspect in Ferghana region was detained while allegedly attempting to obtain US$210,000 by promising to help secure a district governor appointment.

title: Uzbekistan Accelerates Privatisation, Cuts State Role in Economy
summary: Uzbekistan is launching a new privatisation phase, offering state assets, property and land under more flexible terms for private investors.

title: Uzbekistan, Serbia Discuss Mining Industry Cooperation
summary: Uzbekistan and Serbia discussed expanding mining cooperation, including specialised equipment production, advanced technologies and industrial cooperation.

title: UN Rights Chief Warns of AI Risks
summary: UN human rights chief Volker Türk warned that advanced AI systems could pose existential risks and called for stronger safeguards.

title: Indonesia, Uzbekistan Discuss Direct Air Service
summary: Indonesia and Uzbekistan discussed launching a direct flight and expanding tourism ties, including routes linking Samarkand with Indonesian destinations.

title: Tax Committee Explains Rules for Selling Labelled Goods
summary: Uzbekistan’s Tax Committee has explained requirements for selling labelled goods, including product codes, electronic invoices and cash receipts.

title: MBFITI and GENERIUM Sign Cooperation Memorandum
summary: Uzbekistan’s MBFITI and Russia’s GENERIUM have signed a memorandum to expand cooperation in biopharmaceuticals and biotechnology.

title: Japanese Companies Propose Projects for Tashkent Region
summary: Japanese companies have proposed IT outsourcing, smart city, furniture and training projects for Tashkent region, Uzbekistan.

title: China Hosts Seminar on 5G and IIoT Technologies
summary: A seminar on 5G and industrial internet technologies is being held in Wuhan, Changsha and Yichang from 4 to 24 September.

title: Uzbekneftegaz Plans to Raise Daily Gas Output by 3.9m m³
summary: Uzbekneftegaz plans to increase daily natural gas production by 3.9 million cubic metres through new wells and by 460,000 cubic metres via repairs.

title: Uzbekistan, Qatar Discuss Expanding Cooperation
summary: Uzbekistan and Qatar discussed strengthening bilateral ties and expanding cooperation in political, economic and cultural areas on 7 September.

title: Uzbekistan to Sell Stakes in Major Companies
summary: Uzbekistan plans to sell state stakes in major companies, including Turonbank, Xalq Sug‘urta, UzexpoCentre and transport enterprises.

title: Chinese Companies Eye Pharmaceutical Projects in Uzbekistan
summary: Chinese companies are exploring pharmaceutical and medical projects in Uzbekistan, including investment, production, technology transfer and localisation.

title: Uzbekistan Discusses Food Export Growth With Expert
summary: Uzbekistan's Food Safety Committee and international expert Suvra Chakraborty discussed measures to expand food and agricultural exports.

title: Uzbekistan Approves Georgian Nuts, Citrus Imports
summary: Uzbekistan has approved imports of hazelnuts, almonds and citrus products from Georgia following a phytosanitary risk analysis.

title: Uzbekistan appoints first ambassador to Syria
summary: Ayubkhon Yunusov, Uzbekistan’s ambassador to Kuwait and Iraq, has become Uzbekistan’s first ambassador to Syria. During his meeting with foreign minister of Syria Asaad al-Shaibani, they discussed trade and economic cooperation, political consultations and other joint activities.

title: Unique artifacts from seven Uzbek museums on display in Doha
summary: Afrosiyob wall paintings, the “Katta Langar” Quran, Bukhara ceramics and other artifacts from Uzbek museums are on display at the “Uzbekistan: Heritage in Motion” exhibition in Doha. The exhibition explores the development of Uzbekistan’s Islamic heritage and its influence on cultural life.

title: Tashkent and Samarkand join FAO Green Cities Network
summary: Tashkent and Samarkand joined the FAO Green Cities Network, a global community of cities working to build greener, healthier, more resilient and inclusive urban environments. Both cities will undergo an initial self-assessment in the near future.

title: President of Uzbekistan to pay official visit to Serbia
summary: President of Uzbekistan Shavkat Mirziyoyev will pay an official visit to Serbia on 7−8 September. He is scheduled to hold talks with president Aleksandar Vučić and participate in a business forum. A package of intergovernmental and interagency agreements is expected to be signed.

title: President announces “completely new system” of poverty reduction
summary: Regional offices for poverty reduction will be created across Uzbekistan. They will be allowed to distribute part of preferential financing, provide subsidies and interest-free loans, and change terms of loans based on business type.

title: Mirziyoyev congratulates Meloni on record tenure as Italy’s prime minister
summary: President of Uzbekistan Shavkat Mirziyoyev congratulated Giorgia Meloni on making history as Italy’s longest-serving prime minister. He expressed his appreciation for her friendly attitude toward Uzbekistan and efforts to expand cooperation between the two countries.

title: Indian citizens can now enter Uzbekistan with visas from US, UK and other countries
summary: Uzbekistan introduced a 30-day visa-free regime for Indian citizens holding a visa from a number of developed countries, as well as an air ticket to a third country. These countries are Australia, USA, Great Britain, Canada, Republic of Korea, Schengen states, New Zealand and Japan.

title: To visit Thailand, citizens of Uzbekistan have to go to Moscow to pay visa fee
summary: Thailand canceled visa-free regime from 15 September for citizens of 93 countries, including Uzbekistan. To pay the visa fee, Uzbekistan nationals will need to visit Moscow. Foreign Ministry of Uzbekistan told Gazeta it is negotiating easing the process with the Thai side.

title: President of Uzbekistan proposes “SCO-2040: A Space for Common Development” Vision
summary: President of Uzbekistan proposed developing a conceptual vision for “Shanghai Cooperation Organization-2040: A Space for Common Development”. He stressed the importance of effectively addressing emerging challenges while having a clear understanding of what the SCO should become in the long term.

title: What Tashkent can learn from New York’s Central Park. Photo report by Gazeta
summary: Central Park is more than New York’s foremost attraction. It stands as a model of urban planning. Pedestrian and vehicle flow, green spaces, areas for rest: all have been meticulously designed. Gazeta photojournalist Evgeniy Sorochin spent several hours there, documenting how it all comes together.

title: Two years in Uzbekistan: Reflections on change, people and opportunities. Op-ed by Akiko Fujii
summary: Uzbekistan’s greatest opportunity lies in its people — and in ensuring that everyone can contribute to and benefit from the country’s transformation. Akiko Fujii, UNDP Resident Representative in Uzbekistan, in her op-ed reflects on two years of work in the country.

title: Uzbekistan and India agree to elevate relations to comprehensive strategic partnership.
summary: President of Uzbekistan and prime minister of India agreed to elevate the countries' relations to the level of comprehensive strategic partnership. They also discussed increasing trade turnover fivefold by 2030. Shavkat Mirziyoyev awarded Narendra Modi the highest state award for foreign citizens.

title: Uzbekistan, Singapore discuss Strategic and Innovation Partnership Program
summary: Uzbekistan and Singapore may adopt a Strategic and Innovation Partnership Program focusing on investments, technology transfer, public administration and human capital. President Shavkat Mirziyoyev and former prime minister of Singapore Lee Hsien Loong discussed this at talks in Tashkent.

title: Uzbekistan, South Africa to begin work on preferential trade agreement
summary: Uzbekistan and South Africa will begin work on preferential trade and investment protection agreement and establish an intergovernmental commission. In the autumn, around 50 Uzbek companies are expected to travel to Johannesburg as part of a business mission.

title: President announces seven national programs for Uzbekistan in coming years
summary: President of Uzbekistan announced seven national programs covering education, healthcare, economy, environment, rule of law, mahallas (neighborhoods) and foreign policy. The plans include school preparation for all six-year-olds, vocational training for 1 million young people and more.

title: Historic gold: Uzbekistan’s rowers become world champions in Amsterdam (+video)
summary: Shahzod Nurmatov and Sobir Safaroliyev won gold in the men’s lightweight double sculls at the World Rowing Championships in Amsterdam. Uzbekistan’s crew finished the final in 6:21.93, ahead of Germany and the US, marking the country’s first-ever medal at the senior World Rowing Championships.

title: Javokhir Sindarov to play against Carlsen and other stars in Global Chess League
summary: Uzbekistan’s grandmaster Javokhir Sindarov will lead FYERS American Gambits as an Icon in the Global Chess League in Bengaluru. Carlsen, Anand and Firouzja will also compete. The league will be part of Sindarov’s preparation for the Chess Olympiad and World Championship match.

title: Prime minister of India to pay state visit to Uzbekistan on 29−30 August
summary: Prime minister of India Narendra Modi will pay a state visit to Uzbekistan on 29−30 August. He will hold talks with president Shavkat Mirziyoyev to discuss cooperation in trade, investment, defense and other areas.

title: 264 people granted citizenship of Uzbekistan ahead of Independence Day
summary: President Shavkat Mirziyoyev signed a decree granting citizenship of Uzbekistan to 264 people. Some said they had waited decades for citizenship. Since 2016, around 26,000 people have been granted citizenship, while none received citizenship between 2007 and 2016.

title: President of Uzbekistan pardons 852 people ahead of Independence Day
summary: President of Uzbekistan Shavkat Mirziyoyev pardoned 852 people ahead of Independence Day, including 7 foreign nationals, 375 young people, 49 women and 37 men over the age of 60. Since 2017, 31 presidential pardon decrees have been signed, covering a total of 10,567 people.

title: Рослесхоз нашёл нарушения в лесном хозяйстве Чувашии и Псковской области
summary: Рослесхоз завершил проверки исполнения лесных полномочий в Чувашской Республике и Псковской области. summary: Cities are not just places where people live and work. They are where many of today’s most complex challenges converge. title: Brazilian scientists develop sensor for moisture in snack packaging
summary:
Researchers have developed a sensor that uses cobalt chloride to detect when moisture enters food packaging to preserve the crispness of food products such as cookies and crackers.  

The research team, led by scientists at the São Carlos Institute of Chemistry at the University of São Paulo (IQSC-USP), Brazil, placed a starch-based cylinder with cobalt chloride next to a cream cracker. The team revealed that the salt in the cylinder changed its color in the presence of moisture.
